ruling.recommended_action: Issue a SGD 2.42 voucher to the rider for the unexempted detour mileage (Paya Lebar Square stop, ~1.715 km) and remind the driver that a mid-trip stop requested by the rider must be routed along the shortest/most direct path to the named stop, not a self-chosen off-route leg; also confirm the metered waiting charge ($1.04) and the stopped-vehicle period (12:28:50-12:32:20) are consistent with the pickup/dropoff meters before closing.

segment_findings.reason: Northward off-route excursion from the PIE corridor around (1.326185,103.885215) to Paya Lebar Square (1.31747,103.89216) with a ~1.2 km backtrack to rejoin the PIE at 12:34:20 — ~1.72 km extra vs the quoted optimal route. The rider's pre-deviation consent (chat 12:20:55/12:21:25) covers the named stop itself but not this routing change (RD-3(b), RD-5); no LTA incident and only band-4 speed records (not band 1/2) exist on the affected corridor, so no RD-4 reasonable-cause exemption. Refund of extra_km × per-km rate under RD-2.

rejected_claims.reason: The fare is metered RydeTAXI, and outside the single unexempted detour segment the trace follows the quoted 15.472 km corridor; only the ~1.72 km off-route mileage plus the metered stop is chargeable above the estimate, so only a partial refund (SGD 2.42) is warranted, not a full fare refund.
